title: RAID log dashboard
problem: Risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies sit in design documents, steering packs and notes, so nobody sees the whole picture or where each item came from. A Claude skill builds a RAID log from your documents, with a source and a stated-or-inferred flag on every item, and an offline dashboard shows it.

title: Lessons learned report
problem: Lessons from finished projects sit in close-out documents nobody opens again, and when they are written up nobody can tell what is evidence and what is opinion. A Claude skill turns project documents into a lessons file, and an offline report shows the top lessons, the causes and the exact words behind each one.

title: Idea to one-page brief
problem: A good idea often stalls because nobody has time to write it up. This MVP turns a rough idea into the one-page brief the builders need: the problem, who has it, a ten-minute demo, the data and what is out of scope. Use the brief builder on the Submit page, or the Claude skill.
